display.purpose: Duration and countdown only, tabular figures.

large-title.purpose: Native large titles on top-level screens.

motion.name: none
motion.purpose: Only system transitions (stack push, sheets, tabs); no custom animation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one solid action per screen.
components.css: .li-btn { width: 100%; height: 52px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #000; color: #fff; font: 600 17px/22px system-ui; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Radio group for duration presets and block level.
components.css: .li-seg { display: flex; gap: 3px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 10px; background: #F0F0F0; font: 15px/20px system-ui; } .li-seg span { flex: 1; text-align: center; padding: 11px 0; border-radius: 8px; color: #5F5F5F; } .li-seg .on { background: #fff; color: #000; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #E5E5E5; }

narrative.northStar: The instrument, not the wellness app
narrative.overview: Monochrome ink and paper in the Vercel and Uber school: one decision per screen, state legible in a second, color only for status.
keyCharacteristics: Giant tabular Geist numerals as the one display moment
Native tabs, stacks, switches and symbols
One solid ink button per screen
A 2px lock line drains across every screen during a session

rules.name: The Status-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Color states on, needs attention, strict or off, always next to words saying the same.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow labels above headings or numbers.

dos: Name the action and the cost of each level
donts: No streaks, scores, mascots or progress rings
Never promise a block the OS cannot enforce
